content_data.meeting_title: Spring/Summer Collection 2025 Design Review & Concept Finalization
agenda_items: Feedback session on key capsule collection pieces
key_decisions: Established a preliminary sourcing strategy for organic cotton and recycled synthetics.
Agreed on a visual direction for the campaign shoot, focusing on natural light and outdoor settings.
Approved 'Coastal Serenity' as the overarching theme for SS25, emphasizing sustainable fabrics.
Selected three core garment designs for expedited prototyping.
Confirmed the primary color palette, with minor adjustments to accent shades.
action_items: Refine mood boards to better reflect 'Coastal Serenity' theme - Designer Ava Chen (due in 3 days)
Prepare digital mock-ups of selected core garments - Designer Kai Sharma (due in 5 days)
